designAnswers.q1_smallGapTail: Picked: one per-recipient wire gate (scope check, then campaignBaselineReachesViewer with a latch) used by the small-gap tail AND the live fan-out, its latch seeded from the log through the shared campaignViewerVisibleEvents. The session reads the log from 0 once (buildBaselineEvent already does for the join and the large gap); the latch before a frame of sequence s is "campaignViewerVisibleEvents(events with sequence < s) dropped something" (that function drops a fact only when it sets its latch, so visible.length < prior.length IS its latch), OR-ed with any frame the gate itself withheld. The tail frames (sequence > lastSeq) then step through the gate in order. The alternative (campaignViewerVisibleEvents over the whole log, deliver the visible events with sequence > lastSeq) is equally small for the tail alone, but the live fan-out needs an incremental per-sink latch anyway (q2), so one gate for tail and live is the smaller total and keeps one stepping rule for both; the seed still comes from the U58 function, not a second copy of the history walk. noteDelivered still advances for a withheld frame (the recorded 11.1 trade-off), stated in the comment.
designAnswers.q2_liveFanOut: Needed. adoptSavedCheckpoint (CampaignMatchHost.ts:383-393, U96) publishes the PUT route's full-state checkpoint (src/pages/api/campaigns/[id].ts:290) to every live sink, and attachLiveParticipant (CampaignSyncSession.ts:385) admits it by scope alone. The unit implements the per-sink latch: joinMember and resyncGuest hand their live subscription the same gate their tail used (the latch carries on from the history they already read); the public attachLiveParticipant (handleRoomCodeGuestJoin.ts:208) subscribes first, starts one log read and seeds the gate from it; a full-state snapshot that arrives while that read is pending waits, with every later frame queued behind it in order; a failed read seeds the latch as set (fail closed: incremental frames continue, no full-state snapshot reaches a restricted viewer). The other production publishers (campaignHostBatchCommit.ts:125/:227, CampaignMatchHostOutcomeInbox.ts:120) publish no full-state snapshot after the seq-0 genesis.
designAnswers.q3_gm: A viewer admitted to gm and campaign (the GM: campaignScopeAdmits returns true for every scope when isGm, campaignWireScopeBoundary.ts:45) passes campaignBaselineReachesViewer's first line (campaignViewerProjection.ts:100) for every snapshot; rows prove the GM receives the checkpoint through the same small-gap tail and the live fan-out.
designAnswers.q4_unsetLatch: A restricted viewer with no absent fact before the checkpoint has latch false, so the law's third line (campaignViewerProjection.ts:102) admits the system-authored checkpoint: a row proves they still receive it through the tail, and one through the live fan-out.
designAnswers.q5_wireShapeWithheld: The restricted player receives, in sequence order, every tail frame their scope admits except the refused full-state snapshot: no CampaignSnapshotPublished frame at all, then the campaign-scoped events after it (e.g. a FundsChanged). Their mirror keeps the state it had (the last fold before the first withheld fact) plus those incremental facts, so it lags the checkpoint's effects exactly as the join path's fold does (buildBaselineEvent -> projectCampaignForViewer): a pilot or contract only the checkpoint carries never appears; a FundsChanged carrying an absolute balance still lands. Once latched, every later full-state checkpoint is refused for that viewer (U58 Lane A F-Q2).

risksForTheParent: privacy: a restricted viewer must never receive a raw full-state checkpoint after a withheld fact; rows assert the absence on the wire sink for the small-gap tail, the joined live sink and the attachLiveParticipant sink whose latch comes only from the seed.
the GM must never lose a checkpoint: rows assert the GM receives it through the tail and live.
watermark trade-off (11.1): noteDelivered advances for a withheld frame, so a restricted player converges on the launch gate without ever receiving the checkpoint.

the rebuilt-session path (U58 review rejoin row, campaignBaselineViewerProjection.test.ts:245): the latch is seeded from the durable log, not session memory, so a rebuilt session over the surviving log withholds the same checkpoint; a row proves it on real SQLite.

timing: attachLiveParticipant's seed is an async log read; frames still deliver synchronously unless a full-state snapshot arrives before the read returns, in which case that snapshot and every later frame wait and flush in order (noteDelivered runs when a frame is settled, not when it is queued).
a restricted mirror no longer converges with the authoritative state after a withheld checkpoint (by design of the law); coop-campaign-sync/spec.md:148 says the mirror converges.
resync.delivered (the return value, not serialized by bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:1131-1137) still lists the whole raw tail as before; the rows assert the wire sink.
